package com.x;
public class BOk extends BComponent {
@NiagaraAction(name = "faultReset", flags = Flags.CONFIRM_REQUIRED)
@NiagaraAction(name = "clearHistory", flags = Flags.OPERATOR | Flags.CONFIRM_REQUIRED)
@NiagaraAction(name = "wipeDevice", flags = Flags.CONFIRM_REQUIRED | Flags.HIDDEN | Flags.NO_AUDIT)
@NiagaraAction(name = "purgeOld", flags = javax.baja.sys.Flags.CONFIRM_REQUIRED)
@NiagaraAction(name = "resetCounter", flags = CONFIRM_REQUIRED, parameterType = "BInteger", defaultValue = "BInteger.make(0)")
@NiagaraAction(name = "removeRow", returnType = "BBoolean", flags = Flags.CONFIRM_REQUIRED)
}
